svg.title: The Gaussian family, its parameter plane and its cumulant generating function
svg.desc: Left: the plane of the two natural parameters, with the allowed half below a forbidden edge, and four coloured points. Middle: the four Gaussians those points stand for. Right: the cumulant generating function drawn as a bowl over the parameter plane that rises without limit toward the forbidden edge; each Gaussian is a coloured point on the bowl.
svg.text: a bowl over the plane; it blows up at the edge
θ₁ = mean ÷ variance, θ₂ = −1 ÷ (2 × variance); the bowl's height at a point is ψ(θ); points near the θ₂ = 0 edge are very wide Gaussians
